## Activity

During November 2023, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 426 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as part of routine site operations. The completed captures provide the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below. No additional activity figures are included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the completed captures, 19 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.5 per cent. This measure is reported alongside the count to provide a clear view of the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 116 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2. This indicates the midpoint of the recorded grading interval for the month. The referable result count and median lag are presented together to support routine review of grading activity at West Gate Eye Clinic. Overall, the report records completed capture activity, image quality, and grading outcomes for November 2023.
